sloka: नाशुक्लवासास्तत्रासीत् क्षुधितो मलिनो ऽपि वा ।रजसा ध्वस्तकेशो वा नर: कश्चिददृश्यत ॥ २.९१.६५॥
transliteration: nāśuklavāsāstatrāsīt kṣudhito malino 'pi vā ।rajasā dhvastakeśo vā nara: kaścidadṛśyata ॥ 2.91.65॥

translations.english: Messengers, maidservants, female attendants, and soldiers -- all of them in their thousands dressed in fresh garments felt exceedingly proud of themselves.
